overview.description: The United States Oil Fund LP (USO) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Front Month Light Sweet Crude Oil index. The fund holds predominantly short-term NYMEX futures contracts on WTI crude oil. USO was launched on Apr 10, 2006 and is issued by Marygold.
